examples.arabic: ذهبت الى السوق المحلي مساء امس
examples.english: I went to the local market yesterday evening
examples.transliteration: Dhahabtu ila as-sooq al-mahali masaa ams
examples.storyTitle: A Visit to the Local Market

examples.english: Yesterday, I bought a shirt from the shop.

examples.arabic: قالت سارة اشتريت هذا امس ولكنه كبير
examples.english: Sarah said: "I bought this yesterday, but it is big."
examples.transliteration: Qalat Sarah ishtaraytu hadha ams wa lakinahu kabeer.
examples.storyTitle: Daily Challenge: Returning Something to the Shop

examples.english: Yesterday, I called my friend Ahmed.

examples.arabic: حاول الجد ان يشارك قصة مضحكة من الامس لكن كلماته ضاعت وسط الطعام اللذيذ
examples.english: Grandfather tried to share a funny story from yesterday, but his words were lost amidst the delicious food.
examples.transliteration: Haawal al-jadd an yushaarik qissatan mudhikatan min al-ams lakin kalimaatihi daa'at wasat at-ta'aam al-ladheedh.

examples.arabic: امس اشترى احمد قبعة جديدة من محل كبير
examples.english: Yesterday Ahmed bought a new hat from a big shop.
examples.transliteration: Ams ishtara Ahmad qubba'atan jadidatan min mahallin kabir.
